title: Purpir Geysers
description: Purpir Geysers adds erupting geysers to Minecraft! Water geysers in the Overworld and lava geysers in the Nether periodically erupt with custom particles, reaching heights of 7-15 blocks.
body:
Purpir Geysers adds dynamic, erupting geysers to your Minecraft world! Discover natural water geysers in the Overworld and dangerous lava geysers in the Nether. Each geyser periodically erupts every 10-30 seconds with stunning custom particle effects. Eruptions reach heights of 7-15 blocks, creating impressive displays that bring life and atmosphere to your world.
